Class InstanceSessions

java.lang.Object
io.github.protasm.jvmud.engine.instance.session.InstanceSessions
public final class InstanceSessions extends Object
Authoritative connection, Player and Persona attachment state for one hosted mudlib.

Opening a connection, selecting a Persona, rebinding authored behavior and closing the connection are explicit transitions here. Every lookup, input capture, negotiated protocol and output route observes those same transitions. The public session handles carry no mutable copy of the selected actor.

All operations are confined to the instance's execution queue. This owner coordinates engine identity and connection state; it does not interpret authored commands or execute LPC callbacks.

    • attach

      public InstanceSession attach(String id, PersonaAttachment selected)
      Attaches or rebinds the selected Persona without replacing the connection's identity.

      The output route, negotiated protocols and connection timestamps remain with the connection. Captured input belonging to the former behavior is cleared before the new behavior can capture its own input. A second connection selecting the same behavior replaces its former controller rather than leaving two competing attachment indexes.

    • bind

      public InstanceSession bind(String id, String remoteAddress, Consumer<String> output, PersonaAttachment selected)
      Opens and attaches a standalone compatibility session when no transport opening preceded it. Hosted transports normally call open(String, String, Consumer) first.
